explication: OmO is an AI coding and research agent harness: a user describes work, and the agent can plan, delegate, use tools, and verify results. The README highlights multi-agent work, memory, model routing, skills, and computer use. The tree and sampled files support task/workpool engines, model resolution, memory preparation, AST tools, and the desktop engine; several broader capabilities are documented but their wiring is not shown here, so uncertain connections are omitted.
